translations.literal: The letter was submitted and Taizong praised it as good.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, and Taizong praised it.

sentences.zh: 十七年，授太子右庶子，又上疏切諫時政得失，特賜鐘乳一劑，曰：「進藥石之言，故以藥石相報。」

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year he was appointed right vice director of the crown prince's household; he again submitted a memorial sharply remonstrating gains and losses in current government and was specially granted one dose of stalactite, with the words, "You offered words like medicine and stone, and therefore I repay you with medicine and stone."
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year (643) he was appointed right vice director of the crown prince's household. He again submitted a sharp memorial on current government and was specially granted one dose of stalactite, with the words, "You offered words like medicine and stone, and therefore I repay you with medicine and stone."

sentences.zh: 十八年，加銀青光祿大夫，兼吏部侍郎，凡所銓敘，時稱允當。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was given the additional title Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and concurrently vice director of the Ministry of Personnel; in all selections and promotions, the age called them fitting and correct.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year he was given the additional title Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and concurrently vice director of the Ministry of Personnel. In all selections and promotions, contemporaries called his judgments fitting.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗賜金背鏡一面，以表其清鑑焉。

translations.literal: Taizong once bestowed one gold-backed mirror to display his clear mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong once bestowed a gold-backed mirror to display his clear judgment.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，遷中書令，兼檢校吏部尚書、監修國史，賜爵蓚縣公。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was transferred to director of the Secretariat, concurrently inspecting and correcting director of the Ministry of Personnel and supervising compilation of the national history, and enfeoffed as Duke of Gao County.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year (648) he was transferred to director of the Secretariat, concurrently inspecting director of the Ministry of Personnel and supervising compilation of the national history, and enfeoffed as Duke of Gao County.

sentences.zh: 永徽二年，授光祿大夫，行侍中，兼太子少保。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui he was appointed grand master of splendid happiness, acting palace attendant, and concurrently junior protector of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yonghui (651) he was appointed grand master of splendid happiness, acting palace attendant, and concurrently junior protector of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 以風疾廢於家，乃召其兄虢州刺史季通為宗正少卿視其疾，又屢降中使，觀其進食，問其增損。

translations.literal: Because of wind illness he was disabled at home; the emperor thereupon summoned his elder brother Jitong, regional inspector of Guo, as vice director of the Imperial Clan to attend his illness, and repeatedly sent palace envoys to observe his eating and inquire whether he improved or declined.
translations.idiomatic: Stricken with wind illness, he was disabled at home. The emperor summoned his elder brother Jitong, regional inspector of Guo, as vice director of the Imperial Clan to attend him, and repeatedly sent palace envoys to observe his eating and inquire whether he improved or declined.

sentences.zh: 尋卒，年五十八。

translations.literal: Soon he died, age fifty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died at the age of fifty-eight.

sentences.zh: 帝為之舉哀，廢朝三日，贈開府儀同三司、荊州都督，謚曰憲。

translations.literal: The emperor mourned for him, suspended court for three days, and posthumously gave him the post of grand master of the office with equal ceremony to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Jingzhou; his posthumous name was Xian.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned for him, suspended court for three days, and posthumously appointed him grand master of the office with equal ceremony to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Jingzhou, with the posthumous name Xian.

sentences.zh: 子正業，仕至中書舍人，坐與上官儀善，配流嶺外。

translations.literal: His son Zhengye served up to secretariat drafter; because of association with Shangguan Yi he was sentenced and exiled beyond the Ling range.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhengye rose to secretariat drafter. Because of association with Shangguan Yi he was sentenced and exiled beyond the Ling range.

sentences.zh: 張行成，定州義豐人也。

translations.literal: Zhang Xingcheng was a man of Yifeng in Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xingcheng was a native of Yifeng in Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 少師事河間劉炫，勤學不倦，炫謂門人曰：「張子體局方正，廊廟才也。」

translations.literal: In youth he took Liu Xuan of Hejian as his teacher, studying diligently without tiring; Xuan told his disciples, "Master Zhang's bodily frame and measure are square and upright—talent for the hall and temple."
translations.idiomatic: In youth he studied under Liu Xuan of Hejian, learning diligently without tiring. Xuan told his disciples, "Master Zhang's frame and bearing are square and upright—he is talent for the hall and temple."

sentences.zh: 大業末，察孝廉，為謁者台散從員外郎。

translations.literal: At the end of Daye he was examined as filial and incorrupt and became irregular outside attendant of the Visitors Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Daye he was examined as filial and incorrupt and became irregular outside attendant of the Visitors Bureau.

sentences.zh: 王世充僭號，以為度支尚書。

translations.literal: When Wang Shichong usurped the title, he was made director of revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Shichong usurped the throne, he was made director of revenue.

sentences.zh: 世充平，以隋資補宋州谷熟尉。

translations.literal: When Shichong was pacified, on the basis of his Sui credentials he was appointed magistrate of Gushu in Songzhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Shichong was defeated, on the basis of his Sui credentials he was appointed magistrate of Gushu in Songzhou.

sentences.zh: 又應制舉乙科，授雍州富平縣主簿，理有能名。

translations.literal: He also responded to the decree examination in the second class and was appointed chief clerk of Fuping County in Yongzhou, gaining a reputation for ability in governance.
translations.idiomatic: He also passed the decree examination in the second class and was appointed chief clerk of Fuping County in Yongzhou, gaining a reputation for ability in governance.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，補殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: When his term ended he was appointed palace censor within the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he was appointed palace censor within the hall.

sentences.zh: 糾劾不避權戚，太宗以為能，謂房玄齡曰：「觀古今用人，必因媒介，若行成者，朕自舉之，無先容也。」

translations.literal: In impeachment he did not avoid powerful kin; Taizong considered him capable and said to Fang Xuanling, "Observing employment of men through past and present, one must rely on intermediaries—but as for Xingcheng, I myself raised him up; there was no prior introduction."
translations.idiomatic: In impeachment he did not spare powerful kin. Taizong considered him capable and said to Fang Xuanling, "In employing men through the ages, one must rely on intermediaries. But as for Xingcheng, I raised him up myself. There was no prior introduction."

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗言及山東、關中人，意有同異，行成正侍宴，跪而奏曰：「臣聞天子以四海為家，不當以東西為限；

translations.literal: Taizong once spoke of men east of the mountains and men within the Pass, his intent showing partiality; Xingcheng was attending a banquet and kneeling submitted, "Your subject has heard that the Son of Heaven takes the Four Seas as his home and should not take east and west as limits;
translations.idiomatic: Taizong once spoke of men from Shandong and from within the Pass with partial intent. Xingcheng was attending a banquet and kneeling submitted, "I have heard that the Son of Heaven takes the Four Seas as his home and should not take east and west as limits;

sentences.zh: 若如是，則示人以益狹。」

translations.literal: if it is like this, then you show men something ever more narrow."
translations.idiomatic: if it is like this, then you show men something ever more narrow."

sentences.zh: 太宗善其言，賜名馬一匹、錢十萬、衣一襲。

translations.literal: Taizong approved his words and bestowed one famed horse, one hundred thousand in cash, and one suit of clothing.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong approved his words and bestowed a famed horse, one hundred thousand in cash, and a suit of clothing.

sentences.zh: 自是每有大政，常預議焉。

translations.literal: From this on, whenever there was great government, he was often among those who deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, whenever there was great government, he was often among those who deliberated.

sentences.zh: 累遷給事中。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to attendant within the issuance.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to attendant within the issuance.

sentences.zh: 太宗嘗臨軒謂侍臣曰：「朕所以不能恣情慾，取樂當年，而勵節苦心，卑宮菲食者，正為蒼生耳。

translations.literal: Taizong once faced the hall and told attending ministers, "The reason I cannot indulge feeling and desire and take pleasure in my prime years, but instead encourage restraint and toil bitterly and dwell in low palaces and eat meager food, is precisely for the blue-green masses.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong once faced the hall and told attending ministers, "The reason I cannot indulge my desires and take pleasure in my prime years, but instead encourage restraint, toil bitterly, dwell in low palaces, and eat meager food, is precisely for the people.

sentences.zh: 我為人主，兼行將相之事，豈不是奪公等名？

translations.literal: I serve as lord of men yet also perform the affairs of generals and ministers—is this not seizing your fame?
translations.idiomatic: I serve as lord of men yet also perform the affairs of generals and ministers—is this not seizing your fame?

sentences.zh: 昔漢高祖得蕭、曹、韓、彭，天下寧宴；

translations.literal: Formerly Emperor Gaozu of Han obtained Xiao, Cao, Han, and Peng and the realm was peaceful and feasting;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Emperor Gaozu of Han obtained Xiao He, Cao Shen, Han Xin, and Peng Yue, and the realm was peaceful;

sentences.zh: 舜、禹、湯、武有稷、契、伊、呂，四海乂安。

translations.literal: Shun, Yu, Tang, and Wu had Ji, Qi, Yi, and Lü, and the Four Seas were governed in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Shun, Yu, Tang, and Wu had Ji, Qi, Yi Yin, and Lü Shang, and the Four Seas were governed in peace.

sentences.zh: 此事朕並兼之。」

translations.literal: These matters I all perform together."
translations.idiomatic: These matters I perform all together."

sentences.zh: 行成退而上書諫曰：「有隋失道，天下沸騰，陛下撥亂反正，拯生人於塗炭，何周、漢君臣之所能擬？

translations.literal: Xingcheng withdrew and submitted a written remonstrance, saying, "The Sui lost the Way and the realm seethed; Your Majesty set aright disorder and rescued the living masses from charcoal and fire—how could Zhou and Han lords and subjects be compared to this?
translations.idiomatic: Xingcheng withdrew and submitted a written remonstrance: "The Sui lost the Way and the realm seethed. Your Majesty set aright disorder and rescued the people from ruin. How could Zhou and Han lords and subjects be compared to this?

sentences.zh: 陛下聖德含光，規模弘遠，雖文武之烈，實兼將相，何用臨朝對眾與其較量，以萬乘至尊，共臣下爭功哉？

translations.literal: Your Majesty's sage virtue holds light within, your measure is vast and far—even though the martial and civil splendors are truly joined with general and minister, what use is it to face court before the multitude and compare with them? With the ten-thousand-chariot supreme honor, to contend for achievement together with your subjects?
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's sage virtue holds light within and your measure is vast. Though you truly join the splendors of Wen and Wu with the roles of general and minister, what use is it to face court before the multitude and compare with them? With the honor of the ten-thousand-chariot ruler, why contend for achievement with your subjects?

sentences.zh: 臣聞『天何言哉，四時行焉』；

translations.literal: Your subject has heard, "Heaven—what does it say? The four seasons proceed."
translations.idiomatic: I have heard, "Heaven—what does it say? The four seasons proceed."

sentences.zh: 又聞『汝惟不矜，天下莫與汝爭能』。

translations.literal: I have also heard, "You only do not boast, and under Heaven none contends ability with you."
translations.idiomatic: I have also heard, "You only do not boast, and under Heaven none contends ability with you."

sentences.zh: 臣備員樞近，非敢知獻替之事，輒陳狂直，伏待菹醢。」

translations.literal: Your subject fills a post near the pivot and dares not claim knowledge of correction and replacement, yet rashly states wild directness and humbly awaits minced pickle."
translations.idiomatic: I fill a post near the pivot and dare not claim knowledge of correction and replacement, yet rashly state wild directness and humbly await punishment."

sentences.zh: 太宗深納之。

translations.literal: Taizong deeply accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong deeply accepted it.

sentences.zh: 轉刑部侍郎、太子少詹事。

translations.literal: He was transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Justice and junior steward of the crown prince's household.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice director of the Ministry of Justice and junior steward of the crown prince's household.

sentences.zh: 太宗東征，皇太子於定州監國，即行成本邑也。

translations.literal: When Taizong campaigned east, the crown prince supervised the state at Dingzhou—this was Xingcheng's home district.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong campaigned east, the crown prince supervised the state at Dingzhou—Xingcheng's home district.

sentences.zh: 太子謂行成曰：「今者送公衣錦還鄉。」

translations.literal: The crown prince said to Xingcheng, "Today I send you home in brocade robes."
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince said to Xingcheng, "Today I send you home in brocade robes."

sentences.zh: 於是令有司祀其先人墓。

translations.literal: Thereupon he ordered the responsible offices to sacrifice at the tombs of his forebears.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he ordered the responsible offices to sacrifice at the tombs of his forebears.

sentences.zh: 行成因薦鄉人魏唐卿、崔寶權、馬龍駒、張君劼等，皆以學行著聞，太子召見，以其老不任職，皆厚賜而遣之。

translations.literal: Xingcheng thereupon recommended fellow townsmen Wei Tangqing, Cui Baoquan, Ma Longju, Zhang Junjie, and others, all famed for learning and conduct; the crown prince summoned them to audience, and because they were old and unfit for office, all were richly rewarded and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: Xingcheng recommended fellow townsmen Wei Tangqing, Cui Baoquan, Ma Longju, Zhang Junjie, and others, all famed for learning and conduct. The crown prince summoned them to audience and, because they were old and unfit for office, richly rewarded them and sent them away.

sentences.zh: 太子又使行成詣行在所，太宗見之甚悅，賜馬二匹、縑三百匹。

translations.literal: The crown prince also sent Xingcheng to the traveling residence; Taizong, on seeing him, was greatly pleased and bestowed two horses and three hundred bolts of thin silk.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince also sent Xingcheng to the traveling residence. Taizong was greatly pleased to see him and bestowed two horses and three hundred bolts of thin silk.

sentences.zh: 駕還京，為河南巡察大使。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, he became inspection commissioner for Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial carriage returned to the capital, he became inspection commissioner for Henan.

sentences.zh: 還，稱旨，以本官兼檢校尚書左丞。

translations.literal: On return, his work matched the intent, and on his former office he was concurrently made inspecting and correcting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On return, his work matched the intent, and he was concurrently made inspecting left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，太宗幸靈州，太子當從，行成上疏曰：「伏承皇太子從幸靈州。

translations.literal: That year Taizong visited Lingzhou and the crown prince was to follow; Xingcheng submitted a memorial, saying, "I humbly receive that the crown prince will follow in visiting Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: That year Taizong visited Lingzhou and the crown prince was to follow. Xingcheng submitted a memorial: "I humbly receive that the crown prince will follow in visiting Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 臣愚以為皇太子養德春宮，日月未幾，華夷遠邇，佇聽嘉音。

translations.literal: Your subject in folly considers that the crown prince is cultivating virtue in the Eastern Palace; sun and moon have not been many—far and near, Chinese and barbarian, all stand waiting to hear fine tidings.
translations.idiomatic: I in my folly consider that the crown prince is cultivating virtue in the Eastern Palace. Not much time has passed—far and near, Chinese and barbarian, all stand waiting to hear fine tidings.

sentences.zh: 如因以監國，接對百僚，決斷庶務，明習政理，既為京師重鎮，且示四方盛德。

translations.literal: If because of this he supervises the state, meets and responds to the hundred officials, decides the multitude of affairs, and clearly practices governmental principle, he is both a heavy stronghold for the capital region and displays flourishing virtue to the four directions.
translations.idiomatic: If instead he supervises the state, meets the hundred officials, decides affairs, and clearly practices governmental principle, he will be both a heavy stronghold for the capital and a display of flourishing virtue to the four directions.

sentences.zh: 與其出陪私愛，曷若俯從公道？」

translations.literal: Compared with going out to accompany private affection, how is it not better to bow and follow the public Way?"
translations.idiomatic: Compared with going out to accompany private affection, how is it not better to bow and follow the public Way?"

sentences.zh: 太宗以為忠，進位銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Taizong considered this loyal and advanced him to Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong considered this loyal and advanced him to Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷侍中，兼刑部尚書。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to palace attendant and concurrently director of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year (649) he was transferred to palace attendant and concurrently director of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 太宗崩，與高季輔侍高宗即位於太極殿梓宮前。

translations.literal: When Taizong died, together with Gao Jifu he attended Gaozong's accession before the spirit coffin in Taiji Hall.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong died, together with Gao Jifu he attended Gaozong's accession before the spirit coffin in Taiji Hall.

sentences.zh: 尋封北平縣公，監修國史。

translations.literal: Soon he was enfeoffed as Duke of Beiping County and supervised compilation of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon enfeoffed as Duke of Beiping County and supervised compilation of the national history.

sentences.zh: 時晉州地連震，有聲如雷，高宗以問行成。

translations.literal: At the time Jinzhou's earth quaked in succession with a sound like thunder; Gaozong questioned Xingcheng about it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Jinzhou's earth quaked in succession with a sound like thunder. Gaozong questioned Xingcheng about it.

sentences.zh: 行成對曰：「天，陽也；

translations.literal: Xingcheng replied, "Heaven is yang;
translations.idiomatic: Xingcheng replied, "Heaven is yang;

sentences.zh: 地，陰也。

translations.literal: earth is yin.
translations.idiomatic: earth is yin.

sentences.zh: 陽，君象；

translations.literal: Yang is the image of the ruler;
translations.idiomatic: Yang is the image of the ruler;

sentences.zh: 陰，臣象。

translations.literal: yin is the image of the minister.
translations.idiomatic: yin is the image of the minister.

sentences.zh: 君宜轉動，臣宜安靜。

translations.literal: The ruler should move and turn; the minister should be quiet and still.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler should move and turn; the minister should be quiet and still.

sentences.zh: 今晉州地動，彌旬不休。

translations.literal: Now Jinzhou's earth moves and for a full ten days does not cease.
translations.idiomatic: Now Jinzhou's earth moves and for a full ten days does not cease.

sentences.zh: 雖天道玄邈，窺算不測；

translations.literal: Although the Way of Heaven is dark and distant and cannot be measured by peering and calculation;
translations.idiomatic: Although the Way of Heaven is dark and distant and cannot be measured by calculation;

sentences.zh: 而人事較量，昭然作戒。

translations.literal: yet in human affairs, when weighed and measured, it clearly serves as warning.
translations.idiomatic: yet in human affairs, when weighed and measured, it clearly serves as warning.

sentences.zh: 恐女謁用事，大臣陰謀，修德禳災，在於陛下。

translations.literal: I fear women intercessors hold power and great ministers plot in secret—cultivating virtue to avert disaster lies with Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: I fear women intercessors hold power and great ministers plot in secret. Cultivating virtue to avert disaster lies with Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 且陛下本封晉也，今地震晉州，下有征應，豈徒然耳。

translations.literal: Moreover, Your Majesty was originally enfeoffed as Prince of Jin; now the earth quakes in Jinzhou—below there is a correspondence of signs. How could it be in vain?
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Your Majesty was originally enfeoffed as Prince of Jin. Now the earth quakes in Jinzhou—there is a correspondence of signs below. How could it be in vain?

sentences.zh: 伏願深思遠慮，以杜未萌。」

translations.literal: I humbly hope you will think deeply and plan far to stop what has not yet sprouted."
translations.idiomatic: I humbly hope you will think deeply and plan far to stop what has not yet sprouted."

sentences.zh: 二年八月，拜尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the second year he was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year he was appointed left vice director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 尋加授太子少傅。

translations.literal: Soon he was additionally appointed junior tutor of the crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon additionally appointed junior tutor of the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 四年，自三月不雨至於五月，復抗表請致仕。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, from the third month without rain down to the fifth month, he again submitted a memorial resisting court and requesting retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, from the third month without rain until the fifth month, he again submitted a memorial requesting retirement.

sentences.zh: 高宗手制答曰：「密雲不雨，遂淹旬月，此朕之寡德，非宰臣咎。

translations.literal: Gaozong personally drafted a reply, saying, "Dense clouds but no rain have lasted a full ten-day month—this is my scant virtue, not the fault of chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong personally drafted a reply: "Dense clouds but no rain have lasted a full month—this is my scant virtue, not the fault of chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 實甘萬方之責，用陳六事之過。

translations.literal: I truly accept the blame of the ten thousand directions and use this to state the faults of six affairs.
translations.idiomatic: I truly accept blame from the realm and use this to state the faults of six affairs.

sentences.zh: 策免之科，義乖罪己。

translations.literal: The category of dismissal by edict departs in meaning from blaming oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Dismissal by edict departs in meaning from blaming oneself.

sentences.zh: 今敕斷表，勿復為辭。」

translations.literal: Now I order your memorial cut off—do not again make excuses."
translations.idiomatic: Now I order your memorial cut off. Do not again make excuses."

sentences.zh: 賜宮女黃金器物。

translations.literal: He bestowed palace women, gold, and vessels.
translations.idiomatic: He bestowed palace women, gold, and vessels.

sentences.zh: 固請乞骸骨，高宗曰：「公，我之故舊腹心，奈何舍我而去？」

translations.literal: He firmly requested to beg for his old bones; Gaozong said, "Sir, you are my old friend and trusted heart—how can you leave me and go?"
translations.idiomatic: He firmly requested retirement. Gaozong said, "Sir, you are my old friend and trusted heart—how can you leave me and go?"

sentences.zh: 因愴然流涕。

translations.literal: Thereupon he mournfully shed tears.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he mournfully shed tears.

sentences.zh: 行成不得已，復起視事。

translations.literal: Xingcheng had no choice and rose again to attend to affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Xingcheng had no choice and returned to office.

sentences.zh: 九月，卒於尚書省，時年六十七。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he died in the Department of State Affairs, age sixty-seven.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he died in the Department of State Affairs at the age of sixty-seven.

sentences.zh: 高宗哭之甚哀，輟朝三日，令九品已上就第哭。

translations.literal: Gaozong wept for him with great grief, suspended court for three days, and ordered those of ninth rank and above to go to his residence to mourn.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong wept for him with great grief, suspended court for three days, and ordered officials of ninth rank and above to go to his residence to mourn.

sentences.zh: 比斂，中使三至，賜內衣服，令尚宮宿於家，以視殯斂。

translations.literal: As the encoffining drew near, palace envoys came three times, bestowing inner garments and ordering palace women to lodge at his home to oversee the laying out and encoffining.
translations.idiomatic: As the encoffining drew near, palace envoys came three times, bestowed inner garments, and ordered palace women to lodge at his home to oversee the laying out and encoffining.

sentences.zh: 贈開府儀同三司、并州都督。

translations.literal: He was posthumously given the post of grand master of the office with equal ceremony to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously appointed grand master of the office with equal ceremony to the three excellencies and regional inspector of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 所司備禮冊命，祭以少牢，賻絹布八百段、米粟八百石，賜東園秘器，謚曰定。

translations.literal: The responsible offices prepared ritual documents of appointment; he was sacrificed to with a young bullock and sow; funeral gifts were eight hundred bolts of silk cloth and eight hundred shi of grain; he was granted the secret vessels of the Eastern Garden; his posthumous name was Ding.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices prepared ritual documents of appointment. He was sacrificed to with a young bullock and sow. Funeral gifts were eight hundred bolts of silk cloth and eight hundred shi of grain. He was granted the secret vessels of the Eastern Garden, with the posthumous name Ding.

sentences.zh: 弘道元年，詔以行成配享高宗廟庭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongdao an edict ordered Xingcheng to share sacrifice in Gaozong's temple court.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongdao (683) an edict ordered Xingcheng to share sacrifice in Gaozong's temple court.

sentences.zh: 子洛客嗣，官至雍州渭南令。

translations.literal: His son Luoke succeeded him and served up to magistrate of Weinan in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luoke succeeded him and rose to magistrate of Weinan in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 行成族孫易之、昌宗。

translations.literal: Xingcheng's clan grandsons Yizhi and Changzong.
translations.idiomatic: Xingcheng's clansmen Yizhi and Changzong.

sentences.zh: 易之父希臧，雍州司戶。

translations.literal: Yizhi's father Xizang was registrar of households in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi's father Xizang served as registrar of households in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 易之初以門廕，累遷為尚乘奉御，年二十餘，白皙美姿容，善音律歌詞。

translations.literal: Yizhi at first through hereditary gate privilege was promoted in succession to attendant for imperial carriages, over twenty years old, fair-skinned with beautiful features, skilled in pitch and rhythm and song lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi at first rose through hereditary privilege to attendant for imperial carriages. Over twenty years old, he was fair-skinned with beautiful features and skilled in music and song lyrics.

sentences.zh: 則天臨朝，通天二年，太平公主薦易之弟昌宗入侍禁中，既而昌宗啟天后曰：「臣兄易之器用過臣，兼工合煉。」

translations.literal: When Zetian held court, in the second year of Tongtian Princess Taiping recommended Yizhi's younger brother Changzong to attend within the forbidden inner quarters; soon Changzong reported to the Celestial Empress, "My elder brother Yizhi's capacity surpasses mine, and he is also skilled in compounding elixirs."
translations.idiomatic: When Zetian held court, in the second year of Tongtian (689) Princess Taiping recommended Yizhi's younger brother Changzong to attend within the inner palace. Soon Changzong told the Celestial Empress, "My elder brother Yizhi's capacity surpasses mine, and he is also skilled in compounding elixirs."

sentences.zh: 即令召見，甚悅。

translations.literal: She at once ordered him summoned to audience and was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: She at once ordered him summoned to audience and was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 由是兄弟俱侍宮中，皆傅粉施硃，衣錦繡服，俱承辟陽之寵。

translations.literal: Thereby the brothers both attended within the palace, all applying powder and vermilion, wearing brocade and embroidered robes, both receiving the favor of Lord Piyang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereby the brothers both attended within the palace, applying powder and rouge, wearing brocade and embroidered robes, and both receiving the favor of Lord Piyang.

sentences.zh: 俄以昌宗為雲麾將軍，行左千牛中郎將；

translations.literal: Soon Changzong was made general of the cloud banners and acting left thousand-ox central gentleman;
translations.idiomatic: Soon Changzong was made general of the cloud banners and acting left thousand-ox central gentleman;

sentences.zh: 易之為司衛少卿。

translations.literal: Yizhi was made vice director of the office of guards.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi was made vice director of the office of guards.

sentences.zh: 賜第一區、物五百段、奴婢駝馬等。

translations.literal: They were granted one first-rank residence, five hundred bolts of goods, slaves and maidservants, camels and horses, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: They were granted a first-rank residence, five hundred bolts of goods, slaves, camels, horses, and the like.

sentences.zh: 信宿，加昌宗銀青光祿大夫，賜防閣，同京官朔望朝參。

translations.literal: After one night's lodging, Changzong was additionally given Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, granted guard pavilions, and joined capital officials in attending court on the first and fifteenth.
translations.idiomatic: After one night, Changzong was additionally given Silver-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, granted guard pavilions, and joined capital officials in attending court on the first and fifteenth of each month.

sentences.zh: 仍贈希臧襄州刺史，母韋氏阿臧封太夫人，使尚宮至宅問訊，仍詔尚書李迥秀私侍阿臧。

translations.literal: Still further Xizang was posthumously given regional inspector of Xiangzhou; his mother, Lady Wei Azang, was enfeoffed as grand lady; palace women were sent to her residence to inquire after her; and Director of the Secretariat Li Huijiu was also ordered to attend Azang privately.
translations.idiomatic: Xizang was posthumously appointed regional inspector of Xiangzhou. His mother, Lady Wei Azang, was enfeoffed as grand lady. Palace women were sent to her residence to inquire after her, and Director of the Secretariat Li Huijiu was ordered to attend Azang privately.

sentences.zh: 武承嗣、三思、懿宗、宗楚客、宗晉卿候其門庭，爭執鞭轡，呼易之為五郎，昌宗為六郎。

translations.literal: Wu Chengsi, Sansi, Yizong, Zong Chuke, and Zong Jinqing waited at their gate and courtyard, vying to hold whip and bridle, calling Yizhi Fifth Lord and Changzong Sixth Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chengsi, Sansi, Yizong, Zong Chuke, and Zong Jinqing waited at their gate, vying to hold whip and bridle, calling Yizhi Fifth Lord and Changzong Sixth Lord.

sentences.zh: 俄加昌宗左散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Soon Changzong was additionally made left irregular attendant-in-ordinary.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Changzong was additionally made left irregular attendant-in-ordinary.

sentences.zh: 聖歷二年，置控鶴府官員，以易之為控鶴監、內供奉，余官如故。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shenglu the Crane-Control Office staff was established; Yizhi was made superintendent of crane control and inner attendant, his other offices as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shenglu (699) the Crane-Control Office was established. Yizhi was made superintendent of crane control and inner attendant, his other offices remaining as before.

sentences.zh: 久視元年，改控鶴府為奉宸府，又以易之為奉宸令，引辭人閻朝隱、薛稷、員半千並為奉宸供奉。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jiushi the Crane-Control Office was changed to the Attendant-on-the-Sage Office, and Yizhi was again made chief of attendants on the sage; the literary men Yan Chaoyin, Xue Ji, and Yuan Banqian were all brought in as attendants on the sage.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jiushi (700) the Crane-Control Office was changed to the Attendant-on-the-Sage Office. Yizhi was made chief of attendants on the sage, and the literary men Yan Chaoyin, Xue Ji, and Yuan Banqian were all brought in as attendants.

sentences.zh: 每因宴集，則令嘲戲公卿以為笑樂。

translations.literal: Whenever there were banquets and gatherings, they would order mockery and sport with dukes and ministers for laughter and pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there were banquets, they would order mockery of dukes and ministers for laughter and pleasure.

sentences.zh: 若內殿曲宴，則二張、諸武侍坐，樗蒲笑謔，賜與無算。

translations.literal: If there were informal banquets in the inner hall, then the two Zhangs and the various Wus attended seated, playing pitch-pot and laughing in jest, with gifts beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: At informal banquets in the inner hall, the two Zhangs and the various Wus attended seated, playing games and laughing in jest, with gifts beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 時諛佞者奏雲，昌宗是王子晉後身。

translations.literal: At the time flatterers reported that Changzong was the later body of Prince Zijin.
translations.idiomatic: At the time flatterers reported that Changzong was the reincarnation of Prince Zijin.

sentences.zh: 乃令被羽衣，吹簫，乘木鶴，奏樂於庭，如子晉乘空。

translations.literal: They thereupon ordered him clothed in feather garments, playing the vertical flute, riding a wooden crane, performing music in the courtyard as Zijin rode the void.
translations.idiomatic: They ordered him clothed in feather garments, playing the vertical flute, riding a wooden crane, and performing music in the courtyard as Zijin had ridden the void.

sentences.zh: 辭人皆賦詩以美之，崔融為其絕唱，其句有「昔遇浮丘伯，今同丁令威。

translations.literal: The literary men all composed poems to praise him; Cui Rong wrote its supreme song, with lines such as, "Formerly I met Master Fuqiu; now I am the same as Ding Lingwei.
translations.idiomatic: The literary men all composed poems to praise him. Cui Rong wrote its supreme song, with lines such as, "Formerly I met Master Fuqiu; now I am the same as Ding Lingwei.

sentences.zh: 中郎才貌是，藏史姓名非。」

translations.literal: The central gentleman's talent and appearance are real; the archive clerk's name is not."
translations.idiomatic: The central gentleman's talent and appearance are real; the archive clerk's name is not."

sentences.zh: 天后令選美少年為左右奉宸供奉，右補闕硃敬則諫曰：「臣聞志不可滿，樂不可極。

translations.literal: The Celestial Empress ordered selection of beautiful youths as left and right attendants on the sage; right remonstrator Zhu Jingze remonstrated, saying, "Your subject has heard that ambition cannot be filled and pleasure cannot be exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: The Celestial Empress ordered selection of beautiful youths as attendants on the sage. Right remonstrator Zhu Jingze remonstrated: "I have heard that ambition cannot be filled and pleasure cannot be exhausted.

sentences.zh: 嗜欲之情，愚智皆同，賢者能節之不使過度，則前聖格言也。

translations.literal: The feeling of craving desire is the same in fool and sage; the worthy can restrain it and not let it pass excess—this is the admonitory saying of former sages.
translations.idiomatic: The feeling of craving desire is the same in fool and sage. The worthy can restrain it and not let it pass excess—this is the admonitory saying of former sages.

sentences.zh: 陛下內寵，已有薛懷義、張易之、昌宗，固應足矣。

translations.literal: Your Majesty's inner favorites already include Xue Huaiyi, Zhang Yizhi, and Changzong—this should surely be enough.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty's inner favorites already include Xue Huaiyi, Zhang Yizhi, and Changzong. This should surely be enough.

sentences.zh: 近聞上舍奉御柳模自言子良賓潔白美鬚眉，左監門衛長史侯祥雲陽道壯偉，過於薛懷義，專欲自進堪奉宸內供奉。

translations.literal: Recently I have heard that upper-hall attendant-on-carriages Liu Mo said his son Liangbin was pure white with beautiful beard and brows, and left director of the gate guards' office Chief Clerk Hou Xiang's yang path was robust and grand, surpassing Xue Huaiyi—they specially wish to advance themselves as fit for inner attendance on the sage.
translations.idiomatic: Recently I have heard that attendant-on-carriages Liu Mo said his son Liangbin was fair-skinned with beautiful beard and brows, and chief clerk Hou Xiang of the left directorate of the gate guards office was said to be robust beyond Xue Huaiyi—they specially wish to advance themselves as fit for inner attendance on the sage.

sentences.zh: 無禮無儀，溢於朝聽。

translations.literal: Without ritual and without measure, it overflows into court audience.
translations.idiomatic: Without ritual and without measure, it overflows into court audience.

sentences.zh: 臣愚職在諫諍，不敢不奏。」

translations.literal: Your subject in folly has the duty of remonstrance and dare not fail to report."
translations.idiomatic: My duty is remonstrance, and I dare not fail to report."

sentences.zh: 則天勞之曰：「非卿直言，朕不知此。」

translations.literal: Zetian comforted him, saying, "If not for your direct words, I would not have known this."
translations.idiomatic: Zetian comforted him: "If not for your direct words, I would not have known this."

sentences.zh: 賜彩百段。

translations.literal: She bestowed one hundred bolts of colored silk.
translations.idiomatic: She bestowed one hundred bolts of colored silk.

sentences.zh: 以昌宗醜聲聞於外，欲以美事掩其跡，乃詔昌宗撰《三教珠英》於內。

translations.literal: Because Changzong's ugly reputation was heard outside, wishing to cover his tracks with fine affairs, she ordered Changzong to compile the Pearl Splendors of the Three Teachings within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Because Changzong's ugly reputation was heard outside, wishing to cover his tracks with fine affairs, she ordered Changzong to compile the Pearl Splendors of the Three Teachings within the palace.

sentences.zh: 乃引文學之士李嶠、閻朝隱，徐彥伯、張說、宋之問、崔湜、富嘉謨等二十六人，分門撰集。

translations.literal: She thereupon brought in literary scholars Li Jiao, Yan Chaoyin, Xu Yanbo, Zhang Yue, Song Zhiwen, Cui Shi, Fu Jiamo, and twenty-six others in all, dividing by category to compile and collect.
translations.idiomatic: She brought in literary scholars Li Jiao, Yan Chaoyin, Xu Yanbo, Zhang Yue, Song Zhiwen, Cui Shi, Fu Jiamo, and twenty-six others in all, dividing by category to compile and collect.

sentences.zh: 成一千三百卷，上之。

translations.literal: It was completed in one thousand three hundred scrolls and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: It was completed in one thousand three hundred scrolls and submitted.

sentences.zh: 加昌宗司僕卿，封鄴國公，易之為麟台監，封恆國公，各實封三百戶。

translations.literal: Changzong was additionally made director of the palace stables and enfeoffed as Duke of Ye, with a substantive fief of three hundred households; Yizhi was made superintendent of the Forest Terrace and enfeoffed as Duke of Heng, each with a substantive fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: Changzong was additionally made director of the palace stables and enfeoffed as Duke of Ye, with a substantive fief of three hundred households. Yizhi was made superintendent of the Forest Terrace and enfeoffed as Duke of Heng, also with a substantive fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 俄改昌宗為春官侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon Changzong was changed to vice director of the spring office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Changzong was changed to vice director of the spring office.

sentences.zh: 易之、昌宗皆粗能屬文，如應詔和詩，則宋之問、閻朝隱為之代作。

translations.literal: Yizhi and Changzong were both roughly able to compose writing; as for responding to imperial drafts and harmonizing in verse, Song Zhiwen and Yan Chaoyin composed for them in substitution.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi and Changzong were both roughly able to compose writing. For responding to imperial drafts and harmonizing in verse, Song Zhiwen and Yan Chaoyin composed for them.

sentences.zh: 則天春秋高，政事多委易之兄弟。

translations.literal: Zetian's springs and autumns were advanced and government affairs were largely entrusted to the Yizhi brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian was advanced in years and largely entrusted government affairs to the Yizhi brothers.

sentences.zh: 中宗為皇太子，太子男邵王重潤及女弟永泰郡主竊言二張專政。

translations.literal: Zhongzong was crown prince; the crown prince's son Prince Shao Chongrun and his younger sister the Princess of Yongtai privately spoke that the two Zhangs monopolized government.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongzong was crown prince. The crown prince's son Prince Shao Chongrun and his younger sister the Princess of Yongtai privately spoke that the two Zhangs monopolized government.

sentences.zh: 易之訴於則天，付太子自鞫問處置，太子並自縊殺之。

translations.literal: Yizhi complained to Zetian; she handed them to the crown prince to interrogate and dispose of himself, and the crown prince hanged them both.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi complained to Zetian. She handed them to the crown prince to interrogate and dispose of himself, and the crown prince had them both strangled.

sentences.zh: 又御史大夫魏元忠嘗奏二張之罪，易之懼不自安，乃誣奏元忠與司禮丞高戩云：「天子老矣，當挾太子為耐久朋。」

translations.literal: Again, censor-in-chief Wei Yuanzhong once memorialized the crimes of the two Zhangs; Yizhi feared and was not at ease, and thereupon falsely memorialized that Yuanzhong and director of rituals Gao Jian said, "The Son of Heaven is old; he should rely on the crown prince as a long-lasting friend."
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Wei Yuanzhong once memorialized the crimes of the two Zhangs. Yizhi feared and was not at ease, and falsely memorialized that Yuanzhong and director of rituals Gao Jian said, "The Son of Heaven is old; he should rely on the crown prince as a long-lasting friend."

sentences.zh: 則天曰：「汝何以知之？」

translations.literal: Zetian said, "How do you know this?"
translations.idiomatic: Zetian said, "How do you know this?"

sentences.zh: 易之曰：「鳳閣舍人張說為證。」

translations.literal: Yizhi said, "Phoenix Pavilion drafter Zhang Yue is witness."
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi said, "Phoenix Pavilion drafter Zhang Yue is witness."

sentences.zh: 翌日，則天召元忠及說廷詰之，皆妄。

translations.literal: The next day Zetian summoned Yuanzhong and Yue to the court to interrogate them; all was false.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Zetian summoned Yuanzhong and Yue to the court to interrogate them. All was false.

sentences.zh: 則天尚以二張之故，逐元忠為高要尉，張說長流欽州。

translations.literal: Zetian still because of the two Zhangs expelled Yuanzhong as commandant of Gaoyao and exiled Zhang Yue for a long term to Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian still because of the two Zhangs expelled Yuanzhong as commandant of Gaoyao and exiled Zhang Yue for a long term to Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 長安二年，易之贓賂事發，為御史台所劾下獄，兄司府少卿昌儀、司禮少卿同休皆貶黜。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chang'an, Yizhi's bribery affair broke out; he was impeached by the Censorate and sent down to prison; his elder brothers Vice Director of the Palace Storehouse Changyi and Vice Director of Rituals Tongxiu were all demoted and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chang'an (702) Yizhi's bribery affair broke out. He was impeached by the Censorate and sent to prison. His elder brothers Vice Director Changyi and Vice Director Tongxiu were all demoted.

sentences.zh: 及則天臥疾長生院，宰臣希得進見，唯易之兄弟侍側，恐禍變及己，乃引用朋黨，陰為之備。

translations.literal: When Zetian lay ill in the Long Life Courtyard, chief ministers rarely gained audience; only the Yizhi brothers attended at her side. Fearing calamity and change would reach themselves, they thereupon drew in partisan cliques and secretly made preparations.
translations.idiomatic: When Zetian lay ill in the Long Life Courtyard, chief ministers rarely gained audience. Only the Yizhi brothers attended at her side. Fearing calamity would reach them, they drew in partisan cliques and secretly made preparations.

sentences.zh: 人有榜其事於路，左台御史中丞宋璟請按之。

translations.literal: Someone posted their affairs on the road; left terrace censor-in-chief Song Jing requested investigation.
translations.idiomatic: Someone posted their affairs on the road. Left terrace censor-in-chief Song Jing requested investigation.

sentences.zh: 則天陽許，尋敕宋璟使幽州按都督屈突仲翔，令司禮卿崔神慶鞫之。

translations.literal: Zetian outwardly assented, but soon ordered Song Jing to go to Youzhou to investigate regional commander Qu Tuchongxiang, and ordered Director of Rituals Cui Shenqing to interrogate the matter.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian outwardly assented, but soon ordered Song Jing to go to Youzhou to investigate regional commander Qu Tuchongxiang, and ordered Director of Rituals Cui Shenqing to interrogate the matter.

sentences.zh: 神慶希旨雪昌宗兄弟。

translations.literal: Shenqing followed the intent and cleared the Changzong brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Shenqing followed the intent and cleared the Changzong brothers.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年正月，則天病甚。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Zetian was gravely ill.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong (705), Zetian was gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 是月二十日，宰臣崔玄暐、張柬之等起羽林兵迎太子，至玄武門，斬關而入，誅易之、昌宗於迎仙院，並梟首於天津橋南。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of that month, chief ministers Cui Xuanwei, Zhang Jianzhi, and others raised the Forest of Feathers troops to welcome the crown prince. Reaching the Xuanwu Gate, they cut through the barrier and entered, executed Yizhi and Changzong in the Palace of Welcoming Immortals, and displayed their heads south of the Tianjin Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth day of that month, chief ministers Cui Xuanwei, Zhang Jianzhi, and others raised the palace guard to welcome the crown prince. At the Xuanwu Gate they forced the gate and entered, executed Yizhi and Changzong in the Palace of Welcoming Immortals, and exposed their heads south of the Tianjin Bridge.

sentences.zh: 則天遜居上陽宮。

translations.literal: Zetian yielded the throne and retired to the Shangyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zetian yielded the throne and retired to the Shangyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 易之兄昌期，歷岐、汝二州刺史，所在苛猛暴橫，是日亦同梟首。

translations.literal: Yizhi's elder brother Changqi, who had served as prefect of Qi and Ru prefectures and had been harsh, fierce, and tyrannical wherever he went, was also beheaded and his head displayed that same day.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhi's elder brother Changqi, who had served as prefect of Qi and Ru and had been harsh and tyrannical wherever he went, was also beheaded and his head displayed that same day.

sentences.zh: 朝官房融、崔神慶、崔融、李嶠、宋之問、杜審言、沈佺期、閻朝隱等皆坐二張竄逐，凡數十人。

translations.literal: Court officials Fang Rong, Cui Shenqing, Cui Rong, Li Jiao, Song Zhiwen, Du Shenyan, Shen Quanqi, Yan Chaoyin, and others were all exiled for association with the two Zhangs, numbering several tens of men in all.
translations.idiomatic: Court officials Fang Rong, Cui Shenqing, Cui Rong, Li Jiao, Song Zhiwen, Du Shenyan, Shen Quanqi, Yan Chaoyin, and others were all exiled for association with the two Zhangs, numbering several tens of men in all.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：於燕公輔導儲皇，高侍中敷陳理行，張北平斥言陰沴，皆人所難言者。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Duke Yan of Yu in assisting and guiding the stored prince, Attendant-in-Chief Gao in spreading and stating principle and conduct, and Beiping Zhang in denouncing yin malignity—all spoke what men find hard to say.
translations.idiomatic: The historiographer says: Duke Yan of Yu in assisting and guiding the crown prince, Attendant-in-Chief Gao in spreading principle and conduct, and Beiping Zhang in denouncing yin malignity—all spoke what men find hard to say.

sentences.zh: 苟非金玉貞度，松筠挺操，安能咈人主之意，獻苦口之忠？

translations.literal: If not for gold and jade constancy and pine and bamboo upright conduct, how could they oppose the lord of men's intent and offer bitter-mouthed loyalty?
translations.idiomatic: If not for gold-and-jade constancy and pine-and-bamboo upright conduct, how could they oppose the ruler's intent and offer bitter loyalty?

sentences.zh: 宜其論道岩廊，克終顯盛。

translations.literal: It is fitting that they discussed the Way in the cliff gallery and completed their lives in manifest splendor.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting that they discussed the Way in the court gallery and completed their lives in manifest splendor.

sentences.zh: 古所謂能以義匡主之失，三君有焉。

translations.literal: What the ancients called using righteousness to correct a lord's faults—the three lords had this.
translations.idiomatic: What the ancients called using righteousness to correct a ruler's faults—these three lords had it.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：猗歟於公，獻替兩宮。

translations.literal: The encomium says: How admirable Duke Yu, offering correction and replacement to both palaces.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: How admirable Duke Yu, offering correction to both palaces.

sentences.zh: 前修克繼，嗣德彌隆。

translations.literal: Former cultivation well continued, succeeding virtue ever more lofty.
translations.idiomatic: Former cultivation well continued, succeeding virtue ever more lofty.

sentences.zh: 高酬藥劑，張感宸衷。

translations.literal: Gao repaid with medicine and stone; Zhang moved the sage heart.
translations.idiomatic: Gao repaid with medicine and stone; Zhang moved the imperial heart.

sentences.zh: 君臣之義，斯為始終。

translations.literal: The righteousness of lord and subject—this was its beginning and end.
translations.idiomatic: The righteousness of ruler and subject—this was its beginning and end.
